steps.instruction: Allow the sand-water mixture to settle completely (if not already settled).
Carefully tilt the beaker and pour the liquid into the receiving beaker.
Check that the liquid has been separated from the sand.

rules.feedback: The mixture has settled with sand at the bottom.
The clear liquid (supernatant) is poured off, leaving sand behind.
Liquid separated. A secondary pour may be needed for clarity.

outcomes.title: Liquid separated
outcomes.description: The clear liquid has been separated from the settled sand by careful pouring.

safeFailure.guidance: Tilt slowly and pour carefully along the side to avoid disturbing the settled sand.

narration.text: Allow the sand-water mixture to settle until the sand has completely settled at the bottom.
Tilt the beaker carefully. Pour the clear liquid (supernatant) into the receiving beaker, avoiding the sand at the bottom.
Check your separation. The liquid should be clear, and the sand should remain in the original beaker.
